tips_query_id: Unique ID of the query, click ID to jump to the query details page to get more detailed information.
tips_action_cancel: Cancel the query, abort the execution and release resources.
tips_action_close: Close the query and release resources.
tips_user: The user who submitted the query.
tips_start_time: The start time of the query, i.e. the time when the query was submitted.
tips_waiting_time: The duration of the query in the waiting to close state.
tips_end_time: The end time of the query, i.e. the time when the query is completed, canceled or failed.
tips_duration: The total duration of the query, including queued time.
tips_queued_duration: The duration of the query being queued due to admission control.
tips_mem_usage: The sum of memory usage peaks on each executor during the query execution.
tips_mem_estimate: The cluster wide estimated memory usage of this query.
tips_scan_progress: The scan progress of the query, i.e. the completed number of scan ranges / the total number of scan ranges.
tips_query_progress: The progress of the query, i.e. the number of completed fragment instances / the total number of fragment instances.
tips_bytes_read: The total number of bytes read from the data source during the query execution.
tips_bytes_sent: The total number of bytes sent by this query in exchange nodes. Does not include remote reads, data written to disk, or data sent to the client.
tips_state: The current state of the query.
tips_last_event: The latest event reported during the execution of the query.
tips_rows_fetched: The number of rows already fetched from the query by the client.
tips_resource_pool: The resource pool that the query is submitted to.
tips_statement: The statement submitted for the query.
